Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good initial alignment. Below is a short post-call recap and the concrete next steps we discussed. If I missed anything, please flag.

Summary / ask from Payflow
- Target models: customer-facing chat + follow-up reranking (open/compat models)
- Expected token volume: range 700M — 1.5B tokens / month (avg ~1.2B)
- Budget range we discussed: $10k — $20k / month (stretch to $25k for SLAs)
- Unit economics target you mentioned on the call: $10 — $12 per 1M tokens (you said this was a ballpark internal target)
- Throughput requirements: sustained baseline ~450 tps (tokens/sec) with 2-3x peaks for batch processing; concurrency for 40-60 simultaneous user sessions
- Procurement timeline: evaluating dedicated capacity in Q2, procurement + security review aimed by end of Q2

Technical/architecture notes discussed
- GPU preference: you asked about H100 vs A100. We noted H100 gives better FP16 throughput for large-context chat; A100-80GB can be cost-efficient for quantized weights if memory footprint fits.
- Recommended reserved capacity (initial): 4x H100 (sustained throughput headroom for peaks), fallback option 6x A100-80GB if price-sensitive

Next steps (mutual action plan attached)
1) I will send a formal pricing estimate + configuration options (attached) — action: Redwood (me) — by EOD tomorrow
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Marissa (SE) and Marcus (infra) to validate throughput and KV cache strategy — action: Payflow / Redwood — target next week
3) Share SOC2/artifact checklist for procurement — Redwood to provide

Attachments: MAP_Payflow_20260302.pdf (mutual action plan), dedicated_pricing_estimate_payflow.xlsx (estimates)

If that looks right, can we lock a technical call on Tue or Wed next week? I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm a time.

Best,

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing — tech note (H100 vs A100) + TCO snapshot

Hi Sarah —

Attaching a short technical note and a TCO snapshot as requested. Quick summary here so you have an at-a-glance comparison: 

H100 (recommended for performance)
- Pros: ~1.6-2x throughput on FP16 workloads vs A100 for large-context chat models, better nvlink topology for multi-GPU KV cache, lower tail latency for conversational workloads
- Cons: higher list price; higher per-hour committed cost
- When it makes sense: latency-sensitive UX with synchronous chat and tight SLAs

A100-80GB (recommended for cost-optimized setups)
- Pros: lower price per GPU-hour, good for quantized models and batch-heavy workloads; mature ecosystem
- Cons: may require more GPUs to reach the same peak throughput, higher operational complexity for cache alignment across more devices

Suggested reserve sizes for Payflow profile
- Initial: 4x H100 (performance, recommended)
- Cost-optimized: 6x A100-80GB (if procurement requires lower committed spend)

Autoscaling/burst options
- Short scheduled bursts: pre-warm N additional slots for M hours at a discounted committed rate (good for predictable EOM spikes)
- On-demand spillover: pay-as-you-go GPUs for unexpected spikes (higher marginal cost but no long-term commit)

TCO example (attachment): shows per-1M token at 700M / 1.2B / 1.5B volumes for both configs and the impact of KV cache savings (5-15% token reduction scenarios).

I’ll bring the technical details to Tuesday’s call and can run a short perf model for your exact inference profile if you can share a small sample trace (we can sign an NDA if needed).

Attachments: tech_note_gpu_selection.pdf
